page.layout: One block of text on the page: running head and page number at the top, then the text in one column, a centred heading "LIBER" below it. Faint show-through of the reverse page fills the lower half and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: rum eft calidioribus in regionibus, fed in noftris ficca & frigida hyems falubrior eft. Nam frigus apud nos potentius eft, quod poros terrae obftruere poteft, & vapores denfatos detinere & comprimere. Unde hyeme recte fe habente ferenum coelum & ficcum exiftit. Haec de aftris attulilfe sufficit.

page.notes: Running head is set in small capitals: "Institutionum", with the page number 118 at the upper left. Show-through from the reverse page is present and was omitted. The text is read from the scan; "sufficit" and "attulisse" are as far as the print allows. The word "hyeme" is printed with the long-s form in "Unde hyeme", transcribed as shown.
